job.title: NASiC: 3D NAND-based CAM-Selected Multibit CIM Architecture for Efficient On-Device Mixture-of-Experts LLM Inference
job.selection_reason: MoEのdynamic sparse expert activationを3D NAND CIMへ直接適合させ、CAM maskingとactivated expert computationを統合するarchitecture。実験で既存design比4-114.8x performance、3.9-70x energy efficiencyを報告し、MoE expert residencyとflash computeを交差させる重点候補。
